entities.summary: Peter Freiherr Duka von Kádár was of Croatian Serb ancestry Geheimer Rat, officer (Feldzeugmeister) and Inhaber of the Hungarian Infantry Regiment No. 39. He was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Military Order of Maria Theresa. He is remembered as a great adversary of Napoleon and to have negotiated an armistice with the French Emperor at Lusigny-sur-Barse.
